egg_interaction_v1.responsibility: Task-dependent six-coordinate local EE motions for one continuing held-spatula same-pan turn-over attempt, including readjustment and initial clearance. Not robot kinematics, pickup, gripper control or success certification.
egg_interaction_v1.selection_cues: Known retained demonstrated spatula, current observed egg in pan or visibly supported on tool, same calibrated two-view camera/TCP setup. Do not use on dropped tool, unknown support or off-pan recovery.
egg_interaction_v1.entry_conditions: Explicit tool retention and co-motion confirmed; finite narrow gripper width alone insufficient. Scene validity and supported task context observed, workspace authorized, original initial-scene reference preserved. Force-limited collision-aware executor must be validated before physical tracking.
egg_interaction_v1.continuation_conditions: Fresh causal observations at10Hz, same goal/reference and retention, no slip/force/tracking/infeasibility/no-progress fault. Reobserve every bounded segment; executor arrival means geometry only.
egg_interaction_v1.exit_conditions: Agent observes release, inspectable resting egg and empty-tool clearance, or any invalidity/interruption requires arbitration. No learnt stop label; only Agent can confirm opposite face up in pan, or mark unknown.
egg_interaction_v1.successor_readiness: Fresh raw two-view images, current EE/gripper state, explicit executor status and original reference available for inspection. Retreat only after independently confirmed empty tool and safe explicit geometry.
egg_interaction_v1.switch_procedure: Cancel outstanding segment on switch. Keep Agent original reference. Clear policy memory, revalidate retention/scene/controller, then reset with fresh causal history if a supported continuation is appropriate.
egg_interaction_v1.failure_signatures: Missing/stale images or robot state, changed setup or reference, invalid SE3, out-of-envelope width, caller-reported tool_slip/contact_limit/tracking_error/infeasible/no_progress/interrupted, excessive predictive spread. Scene hazards require external interlock; actor is not a human detector.
egg_interaction_v1.memory_reset_rules: Finite five-observation buffer plus immutable initial scene. Reset on session start, interruption, slip/reacquisition or explicit reset. Unexpected sampling interval clears temporal buffer; nonincreasing time rejects. No episode time or persistent phase state.
egg_interaction_v1.observation_dependencies: Original RGB720x1280 two views with per-camera age/validity; T_base_ee, tau_ext7, gripper_width_m, monotonic robot timestamps; initial third RGB; Agent verification flags and commissioned spread limits. No depth, semantic poses, blade transform or future-derived inputs.
egg_interaction_v1.training_evidence: 20 complete original episodes, supplied handoff/control bounds unchanged, i to i+3 measured EE rates, sampled every3 rows plus last eligible anchor. Whole-episode split11/4/5 subject to strict duplicate audit. Human tails6320101/6411901/6463201 context only. Actual counts/rejections/target roundtrips published by prepare_data.
egg_interaction_v1.limitations: Same setup imitation only. End-to-end vision replaces absent metric blade/perception annotations and reduces geometric generalization. No physical trial, verified task success, robust OOD certificate or automatic grasp calibration. Requires separately commissioned tool geometry, gripper, collision and contact-safe execution.
